statements.status_notes: The OpenTelemetry OTLP-proto exporter loads protobufjs/minimal (static encode/decode of pre-generated messages) and never calls protobuf.load() or parse() on external .proto input, so the dynamic-parser code paths these CVEs target are never executed.
